# Forum Fortress anti-spam extension for phpBB

Forum Fortress helps phpBB 3.3 admins catch spam registrations and posts through
its hosted anti-spam service. The extension adds protection settings and
moderation tools to the phpBB Administration Control Panel.

## Download and install

Get the current ZIP from the [phpBB extension page](https://forumfortress.com/platforms/phpbb/).
Extract it into your board's `ext/` directory so the files land under
`ext/forumfortress/protect/`. Follow the [phpBB installation guide](https://forumfortress.com/docs/install/phpbb/)
to enable and configure the extension.

The extension is licensed under GPL-2.0-or-later. The hosted service is separate.
For help, [contact Forum Fortress](https://forumfortress.com/support/#contact).
